title: API endpoint reference
description: An endpoint page: method badges, paths, cURL examples, and a request sequence.

sections.title: Request flow
paragraphs: A typical client creates a resource, reads it back, and deletes it when done.

diagram.title: Widget lifecycle sequence
diagram.caption: Every request carries the same bearer token.

sections.title: Create a widget
paragraphs: Creates a widget and returns its ID.

sections.title: Get a widget
paragraphs: Returns one widget owned by the caller.

sections.title: Delete a widget
paragraphs: Removes the widget. Success returns HTTP 204.
